rule: Every unknown carries what is ruled out, the best evidence, the next offline step and the next hardware step. Historical ids are kept, never silently retired.

entries.question: What write type does the official app use for D2?
entries.best_evidence: the official capture shows ATT Write Command (0x52) on handle 0x0075 = write WITHOUT response, identical to the harness

entries.question: What is the 0x24 comparison in the 2.24 Button-Test parser?
entries.best_evidence: 0x24 is the tagged Smi of 18 (18<<1); verified byte-level at 0x8b06e8 in 2.23 (LoadInt32Instr then cmp x1,#0x12) and corroborated by all 155 live frames carrying byte[1]=0x12

entries.question: Why did the harness appear silent after a D2 enable?
ruled_out: a device-level difference between app and harness
a capability limit of the harness
entries.best_evidence: the harness captured 3,292 valid 18-byte frames across 26 ids with control plane 0B -> D2 ON (no pre-clear); every 'silent' window had no press requested

entries.question: Does a D2 OFF pre-clear before the D2 enable suppress streaming while a key IS pressed?
entries.best_evidence: every streaming window lacked a pre-clear; every pre-cleared window lacked a press, so the two have never been separated. The offline virtual-device matrix shows case C0 discriminates the hypotheses
entries.next_offline_step: done: C0/C1/C2 defined, executor tested, offline matrix committed
entries.next_hardware_step: case C0 with a CONFIRMED A-twice press
entries.status: OPEN - the single first physical action

entries.question: Does the device require a bonded/encrypted link?
entries.best_evidence: BOND_NONE on the phone, zero SMP frames, zero encryption events on both sides

entries.question: Do the connection parameters cause the difference?
entries.best_evidence: official 30 -> 7.5 -> 30 -> 11.25 ms (1 create + 3 update commands, verified) vs harness 7.5 ms; the app requests no interval profile at all
entries.next_hardware_step: apply the documented OS-level mechanism, then repeat C0

entries.question: Which buttons are ids 2, 5, 21, 22, 31, 32, 33?
entries.best_evidence: no physical button produced these bits in any capture; the static label inventories do not resolve them; define.dart getters are offset +1 and cannot be used to name wire bits
entries.next_hardware_step: one button per popup, operator-acknowledged, no order assumption

entries.question: Does RT (id 9) have a digital key id on this unit?
entries.best_evidence: requested in 4 windows + 3 dedicated retries; never appeared; analog byte [16] never left zero
entries.next_hardware_step: physical RT press with analog readback to decide analog-only vs absent
entries.status: OPEN (proven negative as a digital bit)

entries.question: What real DPI value does selector N mean?
entries.best_evidence: the selector is a 4-bit mask; presets come from the vendor's server, so nothing in the APK maps selector->DPI App-side note: 0xFC appears in the write-result dispatcher (frame_config_macros.dart), so the app treats DPI writes as acknowledged.
entries.next_hardware_step: none useful without the vendor table

entries.question: What is the shape of the DPI reply (live: a5 05 ff fc a5)?
entries.best_evidence: one live reply captured, checksum valid, semantics undecoded
entries.next_offline_step: a dedicated static search for the notification handler in all four builds - DONE this pass: no reply-side dispatch on 0xFC/0xF6 found (see results/reconciliation/static-increments-ledger-loop.md §4), so this route is cold; the productive route is a live selector sweep
entries.next_hardware_step: re-read the query and vary the selector while capturing, to see which field moves

entries.question: What do the AB motion/gyro payload fields mean (mode, sensitivity, deadzone, filter)?
entries.best_evidence: the writer AB 07 05 25 <u16 LE> and the query shapes AB 05 05 25/26 are known; the queries return NOTHING on this firmware

entries.question: What is the RGB byte order and the lighting field layout?
entries.best_evidence: the 0x70 writers exist in all builds but no read path exists; RGB order is UNKNOWN in all four builds
entries.next_offline_step: static field trace through writeLightConfig and the 0x05/0x3F sub-commands
entries.next_hardware_step: minimum reversible experiment: one zone, one known colour, visual confirm, restore

entries.question: What selects the D8 chunk class (15 / 43 / 67 payload sizes)?
ruled_out: A4 0A D8 as a commit frame (CONTRADICTED in all four builds)
entries.best_evidence: commit is A4 05 D8 <nfrags+1> <cks>; the 10-byte TranscribeFrame model and subpackageLength-5 arithmetic are reconstructed; the class selector is not
entries.next_offline_step: static branch analysis of the fragmenter in all four builds
entries.next_hardware_step: read a macro back and observe which classes the device emits

entries.question: What are the 10 UNKNOWN byte regions of the 144-byte configuration?
entries.best_evidence: config-byte-evidence-map: 25 PROVEN STATIC / 10 UNKNOWN / 1 PROVEN LIVE; baseline and mutant images both exist and differ in {0,1,127}
entries.next_offline_step: resolve more regions statically from the four builds' config codecs
entries.next_hardware_step: controlled single-field diffs with readback + power-cycle verification

entries.question: Why does the current Windows Assistant leave the ARMORX legacy device type inaccessible?
ruled_out: conflating the two numbering systems (now explicitly separated)
entries.best_evidence: DevMgr.dll has t_BBW_DevType and t_ProductType colliding at 5-7; the classifier switch is at 0x1003212f
entries.next_offline_step: PE xref pass mapping the classifier to the UI device list
entries.next_hardware_step: attach the unit and observe which type the Assistant picks

entries.question: Is there a latent ArmorX Pro factory/DFU path in the vendor software?
entries.best_evidence: devmgr_dfu_analysis.json exists as a starting point; no factory entry point was identified
entries.next_offline_step: dedicated static pass over the DFU/upgrade DLLs
entries.next_hardware_step: NOT to be attempted (no flash/firmware operations)

entries.question: Does the pad re-enumerate differently in normal vs Xbox-compatible mode?
entries.best_evidence: the Windows-side question is about device behaviour, not code
entries.next_offline_step: static prediction of which descriptors each mode would request
entries.next_hardware_step: mode switch on real hardware with enumeration monitoring

entries.question: Which MCU is in the ARMOR-X Pro body?
entries.best_evidence: RCSP-capable service layout + a JieLi AC632N .ufw upgrade library in the vendor Windows software => AC6321A/AC632N/BD19 is STRONG EVIDENCE, not proof; no firmware image exists locally
entries.next_offline_step: static analysis of the vendor .ufw container/signature handling
entries.next_hardware_step: a firmware dump (not attempted, and not proposed)

entries.question: Can an 11.25 ms connection interval be requested reproducibly on Linux?
entries.best_evidence: mechanism research is documented (BlueZ/btmgmt/kernel vs raw HCI) with privileges, adapter requirements and rollback
entries.next_hardware_step: apply and measure without a device first, then with

entries.question: What are opcodes 0xFD and 0xD3, and what does the app's per-opcode write-result dispatcher imply?
entries.best_evidence: frame_config_macros.dart (4.0.8) dispatches write results on {0xFD, 0xFC, 0xD8, 0xD3}; 0xFD and 0xD3 were not previously in our opcode catalogue
entries.next_offline_step: trace the 0xFD and 0xD3 builders and their consumers in all four builds
entries.next_hardware_step: none until the builders are understood
